figure.title: Company-reported retrospective task shares
figure.description: Two zero-baseline bars show OpenAI's rounded retrospective percentages. Previously unsolved tasks were 22 percent of 898 tasks, while 93 percent of board-discussed tasks came from that set. The measures have different denominators.
figure.claim: OpenAI reports that a previously unsolved task set represented 22 percent of all tasks and 93 percent of board-discussed tasks.
figure.doesNotProve: There is no causal implication, common denominator, uplift measure, settled intent, production-wide result, or independent replication.
transformations: Do not divide the values, calculate uplift, or imply causation.
Keep the 198 of 898 count and the separate board-discussion denominator in the labels.
Render both rounded percentages on a zero-to-100 scale.
figure.uncertainty: OpenAI reports rounded percentages. Public counts behind the 93 percent value, uncertainty intervals, and independent replication are unavailable in the reviewed record.
